title: 第十三章 不值一提
novel_title: 魔头别夺舍了，我们正道快没人了
content_zh:
季南北能够断定，这天赋的强度甚至不逊于萧京溪。

    当然，对方的出身背景是无法相提并论的。

    萧京溪那可是真正的天之骄女!

    没容季南北过多思忖，眼前的视野逐渐泛起微光。

    即将进入目标的身躯了。

    视野清晰后，季南北观察起四周。

    眼前是一片茂密的树林，草木丛生，荆棘遍地，植被异常稠密，连阳光都难得穿透进来。

    只是......

    这视角为什么这么低?

    季南北感到疑惑。这个视线正对着树根部位。

    难道这人正趴在地上?

    他想抬手看看，结果刚一伸出来，整个人就愣住了。

    那是一只毛茸茸的雪白色爪子。

    季南北:???

    我好像......

    夺舍的不是人类?

    季南北尝试着移动。

    感觉相当别扭。

    这不知是什么物种的躯体，难以支撑两足站立，用双腿行走显然十分吃力。

    而用四肢爬行......

    季南北毕竟是人类，还需要时间适应，动作很是生疏。就这样，季南北一边熟悉着这具陌生的躯壳，一边在密林间缓缓穿行。

    不久，季南北发现了一处不大的水潭。

    来到潭边，借助水面的映照，季南北终于看清了自己此刻的模样。

    那是一只通体雪白、不带半分杂色的......

    雪白。。。。。。狐狸?

    季南北恍然，他就说那天赋描述怎么看起来有点怪，谁家弟子需要天赋来提升智慧啊!

    除非是那种看上去就不太灵光的家伙，才需要智慧加持吧。

    但放在小狐狸身上就合理多了。

    妖族之中，确实有极少数天生灵智超凡的个体，在妖族里堪称万里挑一的天赋。看清自己现在的模样后，季南北又尝试着模仿小狐狸的动作。

    试图通过这种方式，尽快适应这副身体。

    “听说，未开灵智的小狐狸，常常会一头扎进雪地里找吃的......“

    就在季南北在“搞事”的道路上越走越远时，一声狐狸的鸣叫吸引了他的注意。

    那声音是从精神深处传来的。

    显然是这具身躯原主的呼唤。
content_en:
Ji Nanbei was able to conclude that the strength of this talent was not even inferior to Xiao Jingxi's.

    Of course, the other party's background is incomparable.

    Xiao Jingxi is truly the proud daughter of heaven!

    Ji Nanbei didn't allow Ji Nanbei to think too much, and the vision in front of him gradually dimmed.

    About to enter the target's body.

    After his vision became clear, Ji Nanbei observed his surroundings.

    In front of him was a dense forest, overgrown with vegetation, thorns everywhere, and the vegetation was so dense that even sunlight could hardly penetrate.

    Just...

    Why is the viewing angle so low?

    Ji Nanbei was confused. This line of sight is facing the root of the tree.

    Is this person lying on the ground?

    He wanted to raise his hand to take a look, but as soon as he stretched it out, he was stunned.

    It was a furry, snow-white paw.

    Ji Nanbei:???

    I seem to...

    Isn’t it human beings who take over the body?

    Ji Nanbei tried to move.

    It feels quite awkward.

    The body of this unknown species is difficult to stand on two legs, and walking on two legs is obviously very difficult.

    And crawling on all fours...

    Ji Nanbei is a human being after all, so he still needs time to adapt, and his movements are very unfamiliar. In this way, Ji Nanbei slowly walked through the dense forest while getting familiar with this strange body.

    Soon, Ji Nanbei discovered a small pool.

    Arriving at the edge of the pool, Ji Nanbei finally saw clearly what he looked like at the moment with the help of the reflection on the water.

    It was a snow-white one without even a hint of color...

    Snow white. . . . . . Fox?

    Ji Nanbei suddenly realized that the description of the talent looked a bit strange. Whose disciple needs a talent to improve his wisdom?

    Unless you are the kind of guy who doesn't look very smart, you need the blessing of wisdom.

    But it makes more sense to put it on the little fox.

    Among the demon clan, there are indeed a very small number of individuals who are born with extraordinary intelligence. Among the demon clan, they can be called one-in-a-thousand talents. After seeing his current appearance, Ji Nanbei tried to imitate the little fox's movements.

    Trying to adapt to this body as quickly as possible through this method.

    "I heard that little foxes who have not yet developed their intelligence will often dive into the snow to find food..."

    Just as Ji Nanbei was walking further and further on the road of "making trouble", a fox's cry attracted his attention.

    The voice came from deep within the spirit.

    It was obviously the call of the original owner of this body.
